title: layout
description: Where the launcher and dashboard live (auto, notch, centered spotlight or side sheet), launcher result style, dashboard tabs and widget grid, side sheet placement and the OSD.

host.title: Launcher opens in
host.description: Notch: grows out of the notch. Spotlight: centered over a dimmed screen. Sheet: a full-height panel sliding in from the side.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.launcher_host
x-settings.keywords: launcher host spotlight sheet notch centered search

resultStyle.title: Result style
resultStyle.description: List rows, taller cards, or an app icon grid (other results use the list).

x-settings.label: prefs.launcher.result_style
x-settings.keywords: results look style list cards grid icons layout

preview.title: Preview pane
preview.description: Show a preview of the selected file, calculator result or clipboard entry.

x-settings.label: prefs.launcher.preview
x-settings.keywords: preview pane file image text calculator side

icons.title: Result icons
icons.description: Show an icon before each result. Off gives a text-only, command-line list.

x-settings.label: prefs.launcher.icons
x-settings.keywords: icons text only command line minimal rows

compactWhenEmpty.title: Compact when empty
compactWhenEmpty.description: Show only the search field until you start typing.

x-settings.label: prefs.launcher.compact_when_empty
x-settings.keywords: compact empty search field minimal small collapse

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Dashboard placement, tabs and widget grid.

host.title: Dashboard opens in
host.description: Notch: grows out of the notch. Spotlight: centered over a dimmed screen. Sheet: a full-height panel sliding in from the side.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.dashboard_host
x-settings.keywords: dashboard host spotlight sheet notch side panel

home.title: Home view
home.description: What the widgets tab shows: the stage (a large player, what is next, the week, notifications), a composed overview (clock, player, toggles, calendar, notifications) or the editable widget grid.

x-settings.label: prefs.dashboard.home
x-settings.keywords: dashboard home view stage composed bento grid widgets layout overview

showMetrics.title: Metrics strip
showMetrics.description: A thin line with CPU, RAM, GPU and network at the bottom; click it to open the metrics tab.

x-settings.label: prefs.dashboard.show_metrics
x-settings.keywords: dashboard metrics cpu ram gpu network strip footer

heroTint.title: Tint the player with the art
heroTint.description: The player block takes the colour of the album art, held back so the text stays readable.

x-settings.label: prefs.dashboard.hero_tint
x-settings.keywords: dashboard player hero tint album art colour color

tabs.title: Dashboard tabs
tabs.description: Order and visibility of the dashboard tabs. Drag the grip or use the arrows; widgets are arranged from the dashboard itself with the pencil button.

x-settings.label: prefs.dashboard.tabs
x-settings.keywords: dashboard tabs order hide show reorder widgets wallpapers metrics rail

cols.title: Cols
cols.description: Columns of the dashboard widget grid.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: Placed dashboard widgets: [{widget, x, y, w, h}] in grid cells. widget = player | quickControls | calendar | specials | notifications | levels | weather | metricsSummary (modules/widgets/dashboard/widgets/WidgetRegistry.js). An empty list keeps the dashboard empty; an uninitialized value uses the default grid. Overlaps are pushed down and compacted. Edited in place from the dashboard (pencil button).

side.title: Sheet side
side.description: Auto uses the right edge, or the left one when the bar is on the right.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.sheet_side
x-settings.keywords: sheet side left right edge vertical bar

backdrop.title: Dim the screen behind
backdrop.description: Dim and blur the screen behind the spotlight and the side sheet. Off leaves it untouched; a click outside still closes.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.backdrop
x-settings.keywords: backdrop dim scrim blur background behind spotlight sheet overlay darken

style.title: Power menu
style.description: In the notch, large buttons over a dimmed screen, or a ring at the pointer. Shutdown, reboot and log out are held to confirm.

x-settings.label: prefs.menus.powermenu_style
x-settings.keywords: power menu shutdown reboot logout style radial fullscreen notch hold confirm

style.title: Tools menu
style.description: Screenshot, recording and picker tools in the notch or on a ring at the pointer.

x-settings.label: prefs.menus.tools_style
x-settings.keywords: tools menu screenshot record color picker ocr style radial notch cursor

host.title: AI quick ask opens in
host.description: Notch: inside the island. Card: a small floating card beside the bar. Spotlight: centered over the screen.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.aiquick_host
x-settings.keywords: ai quick ask host card floating spotlight notch island

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Placement of the notch's own panels (voice, timer hub, alarm).

host.title: Voice, timers and alarm open in
host.description: Notch: the island grows to show them. Card: a small floating card beside the bar.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.panels_host
x-settings.keywords: voice dictation timer hub alarm panels host card floating notch island

host.title: Keybind cheatsheet
host.description: Where the keybind cheatsheet opens: over the whole screen, centered, or as a side sheet.

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.cheatsheet_host
x-settings.keywords: keybinds cheatsheet shortcuts host fullscreen spotlight sheet

osd.title: Osd
osd.description: On-screen display for volume and brightness.

position.title: Edge
position.description: Screen edge of the indicator; Auto picks the edge away from the bar (the island style follows the notch edge).

x-settings.label: prefs.osd.position
x-settings.keywords: osd position edge side top bottom left right

style.title: Style
style.description: How the volume and brightness indicator looks and where it lives.

x-settings.label: prefs.osd.style
x-settings.keywords: osd volume brightness on screen display pill island bar edge gauge needle dial instrument indicator

timeout.title: Display time
timeout.description: How long the indicator stays up. Scroll over it to adjust, click to open the controls.

x-settings.label: prefs.osd.timeout
x-settings.keywords: osd duration timeout how long hide
